topography.project_purpose: Wasabi is a decentralized leverage trading protocol for taking long and short positions on long-tail assets, using vault-based liquidity and oracle-driven pricing. The project also includes earning/native-yield functionality and should include Solana when reporting project-level chains or TVL.
topography.relationship_narrative: The perpetual pools rely on vaults for liquidity, with vaults depositing into pools and earning fees. Routers and swappers facilitate asset conversions for entering/exiting positions, while account abstraction factories simplify user interactions across all families.
